name: ISO/IEC
description: International standards bodies producing the most widely recognized information security management standards (ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, 27701) through rigorous multi-stage international peer review.

peerReview.processDescription: 5-stage international process: Proposal, Working Draft, Committee Draft, Draft International Standard, Final International Standard. Requires consensus from multiple national standards bodies.

attribution.attributionNotes: ISO/IEC 27001 certification is the most widely recognized information security management standard globally.

povsAlignment.description: International standards body with rigorous multi-stage consensus review process.
